evidence.note: Approved delivery direction; unchecked milestones do not imply missing all underlying code.

Embed stage decision: the ChatGPT embed is one stage with Play/Pause and Settings (intensity, theme, still imagery, text size), inline only, one computed height, the Chamber's chrome off under a host. Its build plan ends with LIVE-004 witnessed on the candidate after PR 5. Decided by Mateo; the Reader-lane items await Seth's review; two owner questions open.

The witness runbook (PR 6, code and docs): the ?log=host switch writes the host's context and each size report to the console as JSON; the runbook gives the owner the exact candidate, the demo Worker deploy, the developer-mode connection per the current OpenAI page, the one conversation, the five host questions with what each answer changes, the record's template and the Worker made inert. The session itself, and the real-host acceptance it records, are still to come.

Real-host witness on exact main 122b1cb6 (embed stage and RDR-022 included), ChatGPT developer mode, desktop Chrome. Purpose, poster, voice, Play/Pause and the Settings rows witnessed (owner: "voice works"); the host applies the reported height (400 at the hello, 481 after the report). Not passed: no Finished or Play again at the end; the first Play after returning from a new chat is silent; voice and text fall out of sync, the voice restarting mid-passage, after the tab is hidden and shown. Local acceptance stays the CI record.

Fixes the three witness defects: a hold cancels and remembers instead of pausing Chromium's browser-wide speech engine, every pause takes up the phrase on screen with the voice, a new voice clears an engine left paused, and the end draws a replay arrow. Needs a re-witness on a release that includes it.
